name: Cycle Anudaan Yojana
benefit: > **Financial Assistance :** 90 percent of actual expenditure or ₹4,000/- whichever is less.
_eligibility_text:
1. Applicant must be a registered construction worker of the division with a valid identity card.
1. Applicant can get the scheme benefits only at once.
1. Applicant must working as registered construction workers for 3 consecutive years.
1. Bicycle purchased on a grant will be prohibited from sale for 3 years.
